title: Children Playing Toy Organ, 1959 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: THIS IS A Real electric reed organ —
description: A candid black and white snapshot taken in January 1959 showing a baby and young girl playing a tabletop electric reed organ inside their home. The photo captures a nostalgic moment of childhood curiosity and music-making during the post-WWII American baby boom era. The bottom margin is stamped with 'JAN 59'.
